editorial.blurb: A soulful, lovingly-crafted dining experience where live jazz sets the mood and each dish tastes like it was made with genuine care.
editorial.insiderTip: Note the automatic 18% gratuity added to your bill upfront to avoid accidentally double-tipping—and arrive ready to linger, as the chef himself may greet you and the intimate space fills quickly.
signatureDishes: Fried Chicken with caramelized pound cake
